ISC2 AI Workshops are Your Next Competitive Advantage in Cybersecurity
Tags: AI & MLISC2 EventsTraining
Tags
AI & MLISC2 EventsTraining
ISC2 Securing AI workshops provide two days of interactive training covering AI risks, defenses, ethics and real-world case studies. With ten workshops scheduled, find the date that works best for your schedule, whether it is in-person or virtual, earn CPE credits, gain practical skills and build your own AI roadmap.
Artificial intelligence (AI) is no longer a futuristic concept. It is the engine driving today’s most transformative innovations. Organizations across industries are integrating AI tools and services to streamline processes, elevate customer experiences and to support making smarter, data‑driven decisions. AI adoption is impacting all organizational operations as well as the workforce; cybersecurity is no exception. ISC2 recently surveyed global cybersecurity professionals to better understand this impact, with 30% of cybersecurity professionals reporting they are already using AI tools.
Technology is only as powerful as the people who use it. Protecting your organization’s data is where AI workshops can help. ISC2 Securing AI workshops offer a hands‑on, practical path to mastering the tools reshaping our world. Register today for an in-person or virtual workshop.
Why ISC2 Securing AI Workshops, Why Now?
These two-day interactive workshops are focused on the complex tasks of managing cybersecurity risks imposed by all forms of AI, including natural language processing, large language models and neural networks. AI is transforming cybersecurity and with that transformation comes new risks. These workshops go beyond theory and help you:
Develop an AI security roadmap
Align AI practices with risk management and industry best practices
Implement secure‑by‑design and secure‑by‑default principles
Understand AI attacks, defenses and real‑world case studies across industries
Prepare your organization for the evolving AI threat landscape
You’ll walk away with a practical, actionable understanding of how to secure AI systems across the entire lifecycle.
Who Should Attend?
The ISC2 AI Workshops are designed for:
Mid‑ and senior‑level cybersecurity professionals
Professionals with 5+ years of experience
Leaders who need a strategic understanding of AI
If you’re tasked with strengthening your organization’s security posture or navigating the risks associated with advanced AI systems, this workshop is built for you.
